name: Magic Exposure
source:
Bianca's father is a myth buster who had to go on a long trip and asked his daughter to clean the house, especially the attic. When she did that, she found a strange old camera and used it to take pictures everywhere. What could be a normal experience turned upside down when she noticed something weird: the pictures showed something her father always told her about and she never truly believed: spirits from the underworld.

Instead of being frightened, Bianca thought that was incredible until one of the creatures that Bianca photographed didn't like Bianca's new interest and decided to do anything so that Bianca deleted her photos, including spending a week pretending to be her best friend. Will she convince Bianca? Could Bianca find true love within a week?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
比安卡的父亲是一位神话终结者，他不得不去长途旅行，并要求女儿打扫房子，尤其是阁楼。当她这样做时，她发现了一台奇怪的旧相机，并用它到处拍照。当她注意到一些奇怪的事情时，原本正常的经历发生了翻天覆地的变化：这些照片显示了她父亲总是告诉她但她从未真正相信过的东西：来自黑社会的灵魂。

比安卡并没有感到害怕，而是认为这太不可思议了，直到比安卡拍摄的其中一个生物不喜欢比安卡的新兴趣，并决定做任何事情让比安卡删除她的照片，包括花一周时间假装是她最好的朋友。她能说服比安卡吗？比安卡能在一周内找到真爱吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599700/]Steam[/url]]
